title: A merchant buy-down fee debits BUY_DOWN_EXPENSE 23 5000 then credits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY 22 5000 (loan 1 L2)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE transaction posts on a MERCHANT buy-down product, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES, merchantBuyDownFee true) at the buy-down-fee transaction L2. request.buy_down_fee_journal.amount transcribes the loan read-back's buyDownFee transaction id 2: amount 50.000000 -> "5000" minor units. request.buy_down_fee_journal.merchant is the read-back's top-level merchantBuyDownFee true. request.buy_down_fee_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES.json: fundSourceAccountId 5, buyDownExpenseAccountId 23, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22; the product's ONLY channel mapping is paymentTypeId 1 -> 17 and the buy-down fee was posted with paymentTypeId 5, which has no channel mapping, so the default FUND_SOURCE 5 applies (unused on this merchant leg). expect.buy_down_fee_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L2 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 3 entryType DEBIT glAccountId 23 amount 50.0 and id 4 CREDIT glAccountId 22 amount 50.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: when the product's merchantBuyDownFee is set the buy-down-fee debit posts to the buy-down expense account rather than the resolved fund source, then the credit posts to deferred income liability. THIS MERCHANT OBSERVATION IS THE DISCRIMINATOR for the ignore-merchant drive: a port that always debits the fund source posts account 5 here instead of 23, while the deferred-income-liability credit and every amount and side stay observed. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the non-merchant fund-source debit (a sibling vector) and the buy-down-fee adjustment, amortization and amortization-adjustment postings (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
